title: Adversarial Agent Finding Schema
description: Versioned structured finding schema for independent pull-request review agents.

schemaVersion.description: The version of this schema. Must be a semantic version.

findingVersion.description: Unique identifier combining agent name and execution timestamp for deduplication and tracing.

attribution.description: Complete attribution of the review: agent, model, prompt version, policy version, and configuration.

agentName.description: Human-readable agent identifier matching the registry.

agentVersion.description: Semantic version of the agent implementation.

modelDeployment.description: Azure or cloud model deployment identifier, including region and SKU if applicable.

promptVersion.description: Semantic version of the agent prompt file.

promptContentHash.description: SHA-256 hash of the prompt file content for change detection and audit.

policyVersion.description: Semantic version of the verdict policy configuration.

toolsVersion.description: Semantic version of agent tools and integration points.

subscriptionId.description: Azure subscription where the model is hosted.

repositoryCommit.description: Full commit SHA of the repository when the review was generated.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the review was generated.

verdict.description: Overall verdict and pass/fail determination based on policy.

decision.description: Pass or fail verdict based on high-confidence blocking findings.

severity.description: Highest severity level across all findings, or ERROR if review execution failed.

blockingFindingsCount.description: Number of blocking findings at or above the fail threshold.

advisoryFindingsCount.description: Number of advisory findings below the fail threshold.

errorMessage.description: If decision is ERROR, the error message explaining why review could not complete.

policyDecisionRationale.description: Concise explanation of how policy converted findings into the verdict.
examples: 2 blocking findings exceed the policy threshold of 1

findings.description: Array of identified issues, concerns, or observations.

id.description: Unique identifier within this review for deduplication and linking.

title.description: Concise, actionable title for the finding.
examples: Assertion is always true and cannot fail

category.description: Category classifying the type of issue.

severity.description: Severity of the issue: BLOCKING requires fix before merge, ADVISORY is optional but encouraged.

confidence.description: Confidence in the finding: HIGH is ready to block, MEDIUM needs discussion, LOW is speculative.

description.description: Detailed explanation of the finding and why it matters.
examples: The test asserts true === true, which will always pass regardless of implementation changes. This test cannot detect regressions.

citations.description: Specific code locations supporting the finding.

productionFiles.description: Production code files and line ranges related to this finding.

path.description: Relative file path from repository root.

snippet.description: Code snippet from the file for reference.

testFiles.description: Test code files and line ranges where the gap exists.

path.description: Relative file path from repository root.

issueRequirements.description: References to GitHub issue requirements or acceptance criteria not covered.

examples: #30 acceptance criterion: 'Findings are concise and actionable'

missingScenario.description: Specific behavior, edge case, or failure mode not covered by current tests.
examples: The test does not verify behavior when userId is null or undefined. The implementation should handle both cases.

expectedFailureSignal.description: What should happen in the test if the implementation is wrong, broken, or changes.
examples: The test should fail with an assertion error when submitScore is not called for valid userId.

suggestedTest.description: Concrete code example of a test that would address this gap. Can be pseudocode or real code.

additionalContext.description: Optional additional context or metadata for the finding.

summary.description: Summary statistics and metadata about the review.

pullRequestNumber.description: GitHub pull request number being reviewed.

pullRequestCommit.description: Commit SHA of the pull request head at review time.

reviewDurationMs.description: Time taken to perform the review in milliseconds.

tokensUsed.description: Total tokens (input + output) consumed by the model.

estimatedCost.description: Estimated cost in USD for this review.

contextCollectionStatus.description: Status of context collection: complete, partial, or error.

contextLimitations.description: List of limitations or missing context that affected the review.
examples: Issue requirements document exceeded size limit and was truncated
